why: In section 1, the first of the reader's three reservations is that the big box says "נשאר לכם בעוד 15 שנים" ("what you'll have left in 15 years") but everywhere else says 10 years (120 months), so they can't tell which is right. That is a direct mismatch between the years under the result and the years entered and the other headings. It's the first distinct problem the reader raises. Earlier, they mention that 7% is "just an example", but they're only noting a caveat, not complaining about the page.
